ValidationRule.description: Requires that SIC code is entered and not equal to 9999 prior to Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Approved'), OR( ISBLANK(SIC_Code__c), SIC_Code__c= '9999' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SIC code must not be blank or equal to 9999 before Approval can be issued.
